run_batched_coroutine: run an async coroutine with automatic batching of function calls
batch_function: create a batched async function that processes requests in configurable batch sizes
batch_method: create a batched async method on a class decorated with add_batching
batchable_function: create a single-request wrapper that automatically batches calls to a batched implementation
batch_method_with_threadpool: create a batched method that executes each request in a thread pool
